<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex21022025-01-084" status="finalized" part="M" next="ex21022025-01-085"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:3805">kha 1</rs> <note type="gloss"><rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3805">gnyal pa zhang tshes</rs></note> ni thos pas mtshon pa'i dge ba gzhan la yang brtson 'grus rtsom ste | gzhan la brtson 'grus ma brtsams na thos pa la brtson 'grus brtsaMs kyang ngan song na thos pas skyob mi nus pas thos ba <lb n="60b7"/> chud za bar 'gyur zhes 'chad do || 
            de ni ma yin te thos pa la brtson 'grus brtsaMs pa nyid skabs don yin pa'i <abbr>phyir ro</abbr> || </seg></TEI>
